_meta.note: MAST (Medical AI Superintelligence Test) leaderboard, Playwright-extracted (resolves the S249 WebFetch two-table inconsistency). First Do NOHARM v2 Safety F1 (43-row ranking, base models only) + 4 medical capability dimensions (reasoning/CPC/diagnostic/management, top-10). PREVIEW leaderboard. v2 is distinct from the v1 harmdash data ingested in S249.

benchmarks.name: MAST — First Do NOHARM v2 Safety (F1-weighted)
benchmarks._note: MAST (Medical AI Superintelligence Test, Stanford/Harvard/ARISE) — First Do NOHARM v2 clinical-safety F1 (weighted), higher better. Playwright-extracted from arise-ai.org/mast/technical 2026-08-22. PREVIEW leaderboard (scores may change). Distinct from noharm_overall/noharm_case_harm_rate which are the v1 harmdash release. RAG products (LiSA/Doximity/OpenEvidence/Glass) excluded (not base models).
